scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptional and consistently clear within assessed scope. Scores are holistic judgments of observed touch-emulated interaction, not calculated from wins, accuracy or mission score.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent complete mission with useful touch assistance, attractive atmosphere and clear progress feedback; precise combat reading and control framing introduce friction.
reasons.controls: Large labeled targets, working MOVE, target taps, AIM zoom, FIRE drag and route/fire combination. Small drag sample and moving framing made aim reliability hard to judge. Full manual navigation and ergonomics unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coils and upload provide an understandable progression with threats and reload tradeoffs. Two assisted runs support mission coherence, not deep combat or replay enjoyment claims.
reasons.presentation: Strong cyan/amber industrial atmosphere, rain, coherent typography, satisfying visible target and objective feedback. Audio and hardware rendering quality unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, persistent objectives, route/approach assistance, planning map and explicit START FRESH help. Multiple prompts and threat/route/aim interactions require attention.
reasons.readability: Main buttons and health/ammo are legible at 844x390; small enemies, low-contrast geometry, world labels and overlapping announcement/threat banners are harder to parse.
